title: Evaluation preserves addition
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $\iota$ be a type, let $R$ be a resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of parties. For any input assignment and circuits $a,b$, the partywise evaluations of the circuit that adds $a$ and $b$ equal the sum of their partywise evaluations.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
